a.lede: The price increase on refurbished PS5 Pros comes as the console remains out of stock at MSRP on various retailers, including directly from Sony. Best Buy and Walmart have new units in stock, but at around $1,500 each.
a.title: Used PS5 Pros now cost $1,399 at GameStop, 50% more than new ones

b.lede: Amazon slashes the prices of Samsung's entire 9100 Pro lineup of PCIe 5.0 SSDs during the Big Deals sale.
b.title: Samsung 9100 Pro SSDs slashed up to 41% while supplies last — huge price cuts hit all capacities from 1TB to 8TB
